title: Classical simulability of quantum circuits followed by sparse classical post-processing
summary: We study the classical simulability of a polynomial-size quantum circuit $C_n$ on $n$ qubits followed by sparse classical post-processing (SCP) on $m$ bits, where $m \leq n \leq {\rm poly}(m)$. The SCP is described by a non-zero Boolean function $f_m$ that is classically computable in polynomial time and is sparse, i.e., has a peaked Fourier spectrum. First, we provide a necessary and sufficient condition on $C_n$ such that, for any SCP $f_m$, $C_n$ followed by $f_m$ is classically simulable.
